pcs.pc_description: adhere to time limits given by supervisor
visually inspect entire machine for: cracks in welds or structural components Excessive rust, corrosion or oxidation Dents or damage to machine
ensure that all decals are legible and in place as per operation manual
check any hydraulic oil leaks and make sure that the oil level is adequate according to the manufacturer's indication
ascertain proper oil level as per manufacturers indicator
Examine the battery for leaks and ensure that the fluid level is correct according to the manufacturer's indicator
check for engine oil leaks and fluid levels as indicated by the manufacturer's indication
check the holding and control breaks to ensure that they are functioning properly
Ensure proper fuel and fluid levels as per manufacturer's indicator

check the following components for damage, improperly installed or missing parts as per the manufacturer s manual: Electrical components, wiring and electrical cables Hydraulic power unit, reservoir, hoses, fittings, cylinders and manifolds Platform, tower, turntable, scissor stack structures, their components and wear pads, lights and reflectors

Get the following components checked as per operation manual: Hoist Limit switches Pins, nuts, bolts and other fasteners Hitch components Safety chains Engines their fuel systems and related components Hoist Crawler track Personal protective devices
ensure that all structural and other critical components are present as per operation manual
check that all associated fasteners and pins are in position and properly fastened in accordance with the operating handbook
keep inspection/maintenance logbook in which all actions conducted prior to operating the crane are recorded
if a defect is found that is outside the scope of his duty, notify the supervisor immediately

pcs.pc_description: plan and organise the work in accordance with the instructions
position the hook in accordance with the operations handbook to attach the sling, shackle and chains
start the engine as specified in the manufacturer's operating manual
ensure coolant and hydraulic fluid warm up to operating temperatures as per operating manual
examine the assembly and confirm that all necessary safety precautions have been taken in accordance with the safety guidelines

modules.module_title: Loading and hauling of the load

pcs.pc_description: use the emergency stop button to disable all power to the crawler crane in case of a crisis, as per operator manual
ensure safe working load as per operation manual
check wind speeds are within the crane's operational limits
select the appropriate hook, jib, as per the load, site and lift conditions
ensure appropriate boom extension as per operation manual
hoist and release the load at a small height to check the holding and control breaks are functioning properly, ahead of the actual lifting
carry out lifting of load in coordination with rigger as per the requirement
monitor stability whilst moving a load
ensure good visibility of both ends of the crane arm at all times
ensure no obstacles, personnel or other obstructions during lifting operation
look out for people working and hazards such as trenches, potholes and cables
adhere to time limits given by the supervisors
perform in-operation visual checks on critical temperature and pressure gauges as per operation manual
select and use the right type of brake in different situations and conditions as per the operation manual
ensure that walkway rules e.g. operating the crane within the permissible/ allocated areas are followed
utilize judiciously various signaling devices available in the crane
keep a safe distance from other plant or vehicles
work safely in accordance with operational requirements and associated safe systems of work
discharge the load safely at the position and in the manner designated by the supervisor
follow the instructions by the rigger
operate and control the boom and extensions as per operation manual
ensure that the laydown area is large enough to support the load
ensure laydown area is clear of any obstruction and
ensure that no other operators travel on or stand near the crawler crane
inform supervisor/rigger of any problems while operating the crawler crane
when the equipment is left unattended, make sure it is properly shut down and secured

pcs.pc_description: by monitoring the machine working hours plan the correct service schedule
check crane structure and the following accessories as per operation & maintenance manual

check crane structure for deformed, cracked or corroded members in the structure and boom loose bolts or rivets excessive wear on brake and clutch system parts, deformed wedges, defective cotter keys, pins and guard rails

check for the following in hydraulic system of Crane as per operation &maintenance manual: Deterioration or leakage in air or hydraulic systems, safe and effective operation on hoses, pumps and motors, Levels of fluid, Air cleaners for replacement or cleaning

check for the following Control Mechanisms and Monitoring Devices as per operation & maintenance manual: Cables, brakes and levers for poor adjustment or excessive wear. Marking on the load/radius indicator over full range. Load moment indicator, Boom angle indicator, Boom length indicator and Anti two-block system
check crawler track as per operation manual
check wire ropes for wear and tear

Check the following in the main boom as per operation manual lift cylinder(s) telescoping cylinder(s) hydraulic hoses / tubing & fittings holding device boom sections alignment auxiliary boom head and structure
Check the following in the Lattice boom extension boom extension alignment cords lattices end connections
replenish coolants, lubricants and fluids as per operation & maintenance manual
grease all greasing pins and pivot points as per operation & maintenance manual
check battery levels and condition of the terminals and carry out minor adjustments as per manufacturer's indicators
track machine operating hours to assess the right service schedule
complete timely and legibly daily/ weekly maintenance sheets as provided by the company
ensure that suitable props/ support devices are used and the bucket is not raised while performing maintenance
make certain that no engine repair is conducted while the engine is running or remains hot
assess when the problem is beyond his competence and report the problem to suitably qualified and competent personnel
diagnose the problem
handle and dispose waste based on environmental guidelines at the work place
follow reporting procedures as laid down by the employer
complete all documentation in the prescribed standards in a timely manner
report and escalate problems/ incidents as required in a timely manner
report defects precisely to the supervisor if beyond scope of his role
